content: {"summary":"In April 2025 the PAYAPI‑E1042 errors were caused by pgx pool exhaustion on payments‑api‑03/‑04, which hit their 40‑connection ceiling and timed‑out after 500 ms. In October 2025 the same error code appeared during a PgBouncer incident where payments‑pgbouncer‑01/‑02 hit 100 % CPU; the bouncer did not drop clients and failures were due to the payments‑api timeout, not the bouncer itself.","likely_cause":"April 2025 – long‑running queries kept pgx connections busy, filling the 40‑connection pools. October 2025 – PgBouncer saturated a single CPU core, preventing it from serving new connections.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"April 2025 pgx pools on payments‑api‑03 and ‑04 filled to their 40‑connection limit.","evidence_ids":["INC-0035#0","INC-0035#2"],"quote":"Pool filling, then full at 40 of 40."},{"text":"Requests timed out after the 500 ms DB acquire deadline, logging PAYAPI‑E1042.","evidence_ids":["INC-0035#0"],"quote":"New requests waited for a free connection and gave up at the 500 ms deadline."},{"text":"The April incident is handled by runbook RB‑010 for pgx pool exhaustion.","evidence_ids":["INC-0035#0"],"quote":"runbook: RB-010"},{"text":"October 2025 the issue involved payments‑pgbouncer‑01 and ‑02 reaching full CPU usage.","evidence_ids":["INC-0095#0","INC-0026#1"],"quote":"PgBouncer process at 100% of one core."},{"text":"The October incident is covered by runbook RB‑011 for PgBouncer problems.","evidence_ids":["INC-0095#0"],"quote":"Runbook cited: RB-011"},{"text":"During the October incident no client was dropped by the bouncer; failures were due to payments‑api timeout.","evidence_ids":["INC-0055#3"],"quote":"no client was dropped by the bouncer"}],"next_checks":["Check query logs for the long‑running statements that filled the pgx pools in April 2025","Monitor PgBouncer CPU and connection metrics to detect future saturation","Verify that runbook RB‑010 and RB‑011 steps were fully executed during each incident","Confirm that payments‑api timeout settings remain appropriate"]}
